triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Feature · wide full-page record: the first tab (fields) pinned left, the other tabs on the right, fields fill the page when no other tab exists, right-column summary cards removed (figure 41); child of topic #35590, maintainer: 「记录页图 41 的方向定了，立卡」 → p2 as set by the coordinator · size M.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-21T14:07Z · area b1-R2 (epic #35590 child; the maintainer set the fig. 41 direction on the epic).
Area: b1-R2
Session: `session_01L6bhgUZTwDqtEFzNFCVTri` (card thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-j77l7i
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: plugin-detail `RecordPageColumns.tsx`, `synth/recordPageColumns.ts` (the pin rule), `RecordSummaryRail.tsx` (removed; the `?related=approvals|attachments` values, the approval badge rows and the attachment count move to a small file with the same values), `defaultRecordPage.ts`, `DetailSection.tsx`, `RecordTabRow.tsx`, a left-column resize handle; app-shell `RecordDetailView.tsx` (full-page flag, left-width preference, the rail toggle and its shortcut removed, the activity peek, the approval chip step) and the workspace preference key; `detail.recordTabOverview` text in every locale plus one approval-chip string; tests, changeset. No `packages/spec`, no governed surface, hand-written record pages untouched.
Container & model: `L`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening) (optional `RecordPageColumns` props; `rightColumn` / `rail` kept and marked deprecated rather than removed; the seat runs the declaration-face L2)
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, read on main `493ad095`, file `build-seat1/35890/premise-read.md` in the project folder): holds. The tiers measure the record-page container, not the window: under 760 one column, 760 adds a 320 rail, 1120 is the wide tier with a 380 rail. `RecordSummaryRail` has one caller and is not exported.
Basis: card #35890 (fig. 41, the maintainer: 「记录页图 41 的方向定了，立卡」); epic #35590.
Scope, the seat's reading: the card's six items and the coordinator lines. Pinned only on a full page, at the wide tier, with at least one other tab, and when no field group carries a master-detail table (#35889). Left column 400, draggable from 320 up to leaving 400 on the right, the dragged width kept per person per object in workspace preferences. The first tab is renamed 「详情」. The 「审批中」 chip from #35593 gains 「 · 当前步骤」. Narrowing out of the pinned layout writes the implied right tab into the URL so the selection is kept. The right-rail toggle goes with the rail. With the comment panel (#36075) open, the record page gives way and lands in whichever tier its container now fits; neither side needs to know about the other.
Open: which container width counts as "wide". The card's coordinator line says "the width where the right rail appears today" (760); the thread proposes the existing wide tier 1120, because at 760 a 400 left column leaves 288 for a full related list (#35892). The cost is that at 1280 and 1440 windows, opening the comment panel drops the page back to tabs. This goes to the maintainer; the thread writes 1120 as one constant until then.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: parallel with #35892 (the right column's tab content), #36075 (whichever merges second resolves `RecordDetailView.tsx`), #35923, #36095. `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. L1 at L1-c. The PR carries `Fixes #35890`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T14:24Z · #35890 (and #36075's open item 7): when the record page pins fields left (reviewed by fable first)

At 2026-11-21T14:24Z the maintainer picked option A on the seat's decision card, "pin whenever it fits, the left column narrows on its own": the record page pins the fields column whenever its container fits a left column of 320 plus a right side of 400 (about 792 with gaps and padding). When space is tight the left column narrows from 400 toward 320 on its own; only when even that does not fit does the page fall back to tabs. Both numbers are the card's existing drag bounds, so no new design number is introduced.

This replaces the coordinator line "the width where the right rail appears today" (760) and the thread's interim 1120. What users see: on the common 1280–1755 laptop windows, opening the comment panel (#36075, gives way at windows ≥ 1280) keeps three columns side by side, fields | tabs | comments, with the related list about 400–466 wide; it does not jump back to tabs. Below a window of about 1168 with the panel closed, the page also pins (1024 → right side about 504).

On #36075 this closes item 7 (待定) and the first "not checked" line: the approved mock-up's three columns stand, with the real middle width about 400 rather than the 600 the mock-up drew. #36075's "gives way at 1280" is unchanged.

Seat note · 2026-11-21T22:00Z · ruling 7064066204's rule is unchanged (pin when 320 + 24 + 400 fit). But with the maintainer's #36112 F1 answer (sidebar expanded from 1280), windows of about 1280–1475 with the sidebar expanded drop to the tab row when the comment panel opens; collapsing the sidebar restores fields | tabs | comments.
